title: Particles: же, ведь, разве, неужели, даже

items: on the other hand, whereas, as for, as to
: ever, on earth, for goodness' sake
He’s an American; she, **on the other hand**, is Russian.
**Right** on the first page there was a mistake.
На сле́дующий **же** день рабо́та была́ гото́ва.
The **very** next day the work was finished.
Он лежи́т, **ведь** на про́шлой неде́ле он заболе́л
He’s in bed, as last week he fell ill.
**Ра́зве** ты ещё не защити́л диссерта́цию? **Ра́зве** тако́е быва́ет?
Have you **really** not yet defended your thesis? Is this **really** the case?
**Perhaps** someone will give me a loan?
Don't you think he should count from the end?
I will certainly do it **unless** I get sick.
Кино́ я не смотрю́, **ра́зве что** коме́дии.
I don't watch any films **except** comedies, **maybe**.
You can slow down or **even** stop.

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: «Ты здесь затем, чтобы исполнять мои распоряжения». — «Как ___ ((emphasis)), размечтался!»
exercises.prompt: "You're here to follow my orders." "You wish!"
exercises.why: **же** — an emphatic particle, placed right after the word it stresses.

exercises.q: Расстояние между Далласом и Хьюстоном примерно такое ___ ((emphasis)), как между Сеулом и Пусаном.
exercises.prompt: The distance between Dallas and Houston is similar to that between Seoul and Busan.
exercises.why: **же** — an emphatic particle, placed right after the word it stresses.

exercises.q: «___ (really?) она не прелесть? Думаю, мы неплохо поладим». — «Аналогично».
exercises.prompt: "Isn't she nice? I think we'll get on just fine." "Same here."

exercises.q: Почему ты так ржёшь над его шутками? Они ___ (even) не весёлые.
exercises.prompt: Why do you laugh so hard at his jokes? They're not even funny.

exercises.q: ___ (even) стеклянный глаз может увидеть свою слепоту.
exercises.prompt: Even a glass eye can see its blindness.
He's always late. What a slowpoke!
exercises.why: **же** — an emphatic particle, placed right after the word it stresses.

exercises.q: От такого гада мне ___ (even) колбасы не надо.
exercises.prompt: I wouldn't even accept sausage from a bastard like that.

exercises.q: Доренда реально классная девка, ___ (after all, you know) она делится со мной своими печеньками.
exercises.prompt: Dorenda really is a nice girl. She shares her cookies with me.
exercises.why: **ведь** — a particle meaning «after all»: it reminds the listener of something known.

exercises.q: «С каким полом вы себя отождествляете?» – «Я мужчина, ___ (really?) не видно?»
exercises.prompt: "Which gender do you identify with?" "I'm a man. Isn't it obvious?"

exercises.q: Том раздражается, ___ (after all, you know) он всегда должен выбирать свой путь.
exercises.prompt: Tom is irritating because he always has to have his own way.
exercises.why: **ведь** — a particle meaning «after all»: it reminds the listener of something known.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (after all, you know) прямо-таки мастерски играешь на гитаре?
exercises.prompt: You play the guitar quite like a professional, don't you?
exercises.why: **ведь** — a particle meaning «after all»: it reminds the listener of something known.

exercises.prompt: Does the sky touch the earth?

exercises.q: ___ (can it be?) я каждый раз должен всё это проделывать?
exercises.prompt: Must I always go through this?
exercises.why: **Неужели** — «can it be?»: a question of surprise or doubt.

exercises.q: ___ (can it be?) люди всё ещё говорят об этом мерзавце?
exercises.prompt: Are people still talking about this creep?
exercises.why: **Неужели** — «can it be?»: a question of surprise or doubt.

exercises.q: У меня сегодня с утра першит в горле. ___ (can it be?) я простудился?
exercises.prompt: I've had a tickle in my throat since this morning. Have I really caught a cold?
exercises.why: **Неужели** — «can it be?»: a question of surprise or doubt.
